lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Zesty Oregano Chicken and Couscous
dishes.title: Lemon and oregano chicken with roasted vegetables and giant couscous
dishes.method: Assemble the plate by taking a portion of chicken, roasted vegetables and giant couscous from their boxes. Serve cold or at room temperature, garnished with chopped parsley.
dishes.why: A high-protein lunch that uses the fresh batch of preparations from today's session.

dishes.name: Fragrant Beef and Lentil Keema
dishes.title: Spiced beef and lentil keema with basmati rice
dishes.method: Boil the rice in salted water until tender. While it cooks, reheat a portion of the keema in a small pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Serve the keema over the rice with coriander.
dishes.why: The warm element makes this a proper Osric-approved dinner, providing starch after a day of activity.

dishes.name: Simple Scrambled Eggs on Toast
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs on buttered wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Whisk the eggs and scramble them in a pan with a little butter. Toast the bread and serve the eggs on top.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-focused start to the day that is quick to prepare.

dishes.name: Honey and Seed Greek Yogurt
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with honey and pumpkin seeds
dishes.method: Divide the yogurt into bowls. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.
dishes.why: A no-cook breakfast that works perfectly while the kitchen table is out of use.

dishes.name: Keema and Spinach Flatbreads
dishes.title: Beef keema and fresh spinach in warm flatbreads
dishes.method: Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan. Reheat the keema in another pan until hot. Fill the flatbreads with spinach and the keema. These can be eaten easily without a table.
dishes.why: Hand-held food is essential today with the kitchen table under a dust sheet.

dishes.name: Warm Mediterranean Chicken Bowl
dishes.title: Warm chicken, roasted vegetables and giant couscous
dishes.method: Place the chicken, vegetables, and couscous in a large pan with a splash of water and oil. Cover and heat through over a medium flame until hot. Serve in bowls.
dishes.why: A warm dinner that is easy to eat from a bowl while the hallway is being painted.

dishes.name: Protein-Packed Keema Rice
dishes.title: Beef and lentil keema with basmati rice
dishes.method: Cook the rice fresh. Reheat the final portion of keema in a pan until steaming. Combine and serve.
dishes.why: Utilises the final portion of the keema batch for a substantial lunch.

dishes.name: Golden Pan-Fried Fish
dishes.title: Pan-seared white fish with roasted vegetables and couscous
dishes.method: Season the fish and sear in butter for 3 minutes per side. Reheat the remaining vegetables and couscous in a separate pan. Serve the fish on top with a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.why: Fresh fish adds variety at the end of the stretch while finishing the batches.

dishes.name: Quick Morning Eggs
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs on wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Scramble the eggs in butter and serve on toasted wholemeal bread.
dishes.why: A reliable, high-protein breakfast to finish the working week.

preparations.title: Roasted Lemon and Oregano Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Rub the chicken with oil, oregano, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Roast at 200°C for 40-45 minutes until the skin is crisp and the meat is cooked through.

preparations.title: Roasted Red Peppers and Courgettes
preparations.method: Chop the peppers and courgettes into large chunks. Toss with olive oil and salt. Roast alongside the chicken for 30-35 minutes until softened and slightly charred.

preparations.title: Beef and Lentil Keema with Peas
preparations.method: Sauté diced onions and garlic in oil. Add beef mince and brown. Stir in the lentils, spices, and peas. Simmer for 20 minutes until flavours are well combined.

preparations.title: Giant Couscous in Vegetable Stock
preparations.method: Bring the stock to a boil. Add the giant couscous, reduce heat, and simmer for 10-12 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the pearls are tender.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Prepare the chicken and vegetables; place them in the oven on separate trays. While they roast, start the keema on the hob by sautéing onions and browning the beef. Once the keema is simmering, boil the stock and cook the giant couscous. When everything is cooked, weigh the preparations into the named boxes for the week.
